issues.title: Single successful live analysis is insufficient as a capacity correctness prerequisite
evidence: live validation 36956086874 passed

C2 decision approved by user through merged PR #184 (b6fb62c457d08b73a256f1d014e67b8fcdb07cf4): freeze exactly five sequential integrated analyses at concurrency 1 before any capacity execution; 5/5 is required and no whole-gate automatic rerun is permitted

C2 implementation reuses the existing backend live-validation workflow and existing GCP image-publish/revision-rollout paths; no new workflow, backend source, IaC, model, retrieval, or runtime-sizing change is authorized

Live C2 gate run 36985305485 executed the accepted exact runtime identity and stopped on attempt 1 with classification CORRECTNESS_FAILURE; runtime-identity evidence recorded source 8d72c91767c25705d460551babfc4fc079ce7d80, image sha256:221e11378f2e73557c1fc0933ea09c629c5120c41360917f5bedb9d3b213768c, fixture SHA-256 a254981735b1060513251cfd9d6dcab82de8a818730f10b128d1c3904635c8c8, backend restart count 0, concurrency 1

Run 36985305485 exposed a C2 evidence-contract defect: the failed-attempt artifact retained only attempt/classification/reason/status and omitted the known project ID, AnalysisJob ID, and bounded safe failure category, preventing post-run root-cause classification; one bounded repair iteration is being used without changing C-ARCH-05 acceptance
acceptance: a frozen repeated correctness gate passes before capacity execution
repeat count and acceptance are selected before the live gate rather than retrofitted

M0_MECHANICAL_SYNC.rule: generated summary synchronization only; no ledger semantic change

M1_EVIDENCE_STATE.rule: predeclared acceptance unchanged; only evidence append and permitted status transition

D_DECISION.rule: architecture choice, acceptance change, severity/ownership change, residual-risk acceptance, or scope expansion

operating_boundary.corpus_role: curated project patterns, decisions, representative examples; not an exhaustive AWS provider encyclopedia
operating_boundary.schema_role: authoritative executable resource schema for the exact bundled AWS provider
operating_boundary.schema_distribution: generated during backend image build from the exact bundled provider; not committed as a full generated schema dump and not fetched from the registry at request time

request_context_contract: fact extraction may identify any aws_[a-z0-9_]+ resource type, not only types already present in the curated corpus
candidate resource types are the bounded union of extracted fact resource types and resource types carried by retrieved curated references
candidate types must exist in the exact local AWS 5.100.0 schema catalog before schema evidence is injected
only the request-relevant compact schema summaries are added to generation context
a resource does not need a curated corpus document when facts identify it and the exact provider catalog supports it
generated deployable AWS resource types must remain within the request candidate set and exact provider catalog
module blocks and non-AWS deployable providers are outside the C1 executable envelope
recovery_contract: generation provider-call budget is at most two
existing output-truncation compact retry and sensitive-credential recovery share the same two-call budget
a new contract/CLI failure class does not automatically gain another regeneration path
second-attempt contract failure and Terraform CLI executable failure fail closed
diagnostic_contract: Terraform init timeout is distinct from init non-zero failure
provider-closure/init-configuration/validate-configuration/internal CLI classes are represented by bounded stable categories
raw generated Terraform, credentials, and unbounded CLI output are not emitted as diagnostics
rejected: keep generation grounded only to the current 30-resource curated corpus
embed and ingest the entire AWS Provider documentation set into OpenSearch
query the public Terraform Registry dynamically on each analysis request
add provider-specific retries one failure class at a time

c2_decision.pass_rule: all five sequential attempts satisfy the frozen integrated correctness contract under one exact runtime identity
c2_decision.rerun_rule: no automatic whole-gate rerun; failed or external-variance-inconclusive execution requires a new user checkpoint
live_prerequisite: publish one immutable backend image from the exact approved main SHA using the existing GCP Backend Image Publish workflow
roll out that exact digest using the existing backend-revision-rollout operation
run one separately approved protected C2 five-request gate
